179795.overview:
In terms of both interface and setting, this license was atypical of adventures at the time. Enid Blyton's Famous Five books told of jolly adventures on mysterious treasure islands played out by a group of well-mannered inquisitive youngsters. The story takes in Aunt Fanny's cottage, a fishing boat, a forest and a courtyard among other locations.

This is brought to life as an interactive fiction game, using a purely keyboard-driven interface. Descriptions are written in Blytonesque language. You can control any of the four human characters at any time, and must often swap between them. You can EXAMine and TAKE objects, TALK to people and even attack each other.

182890.overview: Football management game from FRED Publishing

459492.overview:
Finally the Sam Coupe gets its version of this classic, frustrating, casual game originally released for mobile in 2013.

The objective is to direct a flying bird, which moves continuously to the right, between each oncoming set of pipes without colliding with them, which otherwise ends the game. The bird briefly flaps upward each time the player presses the Space, F0 or 0 key . If the button is not pressed, the bird falls due to gravity.

This version was coded by Howard Price over 2 weeks from late January to February 2021.

Instructions

Tap to flap:  Space, F0 or 0 to flap your wings and avoid the Mario pipes.

F9: Toggle music

F8: Toggle sound effects

459848.overview:
Football in the year 2090 is a little different to today’s tame game. Lasers, killer robots and deadly traps all feature as normal parts of the game. You are a new recruit to the team and have to go through the rigourous training schedule before being accepted as a member of the team. This program simulates that training. Can you survive to join the team?

One of two games included on the Sam Multipack 1 compilation by Enigma Variations. 

Future Ball is a futuristic version of the ZX Spectrum game Soccer Challenge, also released by Enigma Variations in 1990.

Cheat: Enter your name as HAPPY on the high score table, and you’ll be able to start the top challenge from the beginning of the game.
